_published_faq.name: How do I add ViewPrinter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ViewPrinter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://viewprinter.tech/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ViewPrinter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ViewPrinter lists 15 MCP tools, including accounts_connect, accounts_list, campaigns_create, campaigns_list, campaigns_plan, campaigns_update, media_confirm, media_delete, media_list, media_upload, platforms_list, and posts_cancel.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ViewPrinter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to ViewPrinter in sales-and-marketing on the Manufact MCP catalog include Griddo AX Docs, Rocket Sloth, Affonso.io, Datacircle, and Tolt.
ViewPrinter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ViewPrinter is developed by VMGM Software. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
